q: What does "account for" mean in paragraph 3?
explain: account for 在此指「解釋原因」：原報告未說明為何接手任務會延誤。它不是「分派責任」；「納入考量」通常用 take into account，應區分兩種搭配。

subject: english
q: 自從學校圖書館延長開放時間，我們就常去那裡讀書。
answer: We have often studied in the school library since it extended its opening hours.
points: 常去讀書：have often studied／gone … to study
學校圖書館：in／at／to the school library
自從延長：since it extended
開放時間：its opening hours
explain: 從過去持續到現在的情況用現在完成式，since 後接過去的起始事件。常見錯誤是把 since 子句也寫成現在完成式；此處 extended 表示延長時間這個已發生的事件。

subject: english
q: 救援人員昨晚抵達村莊前，河水早已淹過唯一的橋梁。
answer: The river had already flooded the only bridge before the rescue workers reached the village last night.
points: 早已淹過：had already flooded
唯一的橋梁：the only bridge
抵達村莊前：before … reached／arrived at …
救援人員昨晚抵達：rescue workers … last night
explain: 河水淹橋先於救援人員抵達，用 had 加過去分詞；抵達則用過去簡單式。常見錯誤是兩個動作都用過去完成式。before 引導表示較晚事件的時間子句。

subject: english
q: 為了找出問題，工程師從早上起就一直在測試這個程式。
answer: The engineers have been testing this program since this morning to find the problem.
points: 一直在測試：has／have been testing
這個程式：this program
從早上起：since this morning
為了找出問題：to find the problem
explain: 強調測試從早上持續到現在，用 has／have been 加 V-ing。常見錯誤是漏掉 been，寫成 have testing；中文未限定工程師人數，單數用 has，複數用 have。

subject: english
q: 醫師一公布檢查結果，我就會調整每天的飲食。
answer: I will change my daily diet as soon as the doctor announces the test results.
points: 一公布就會：will … as soon as + 現在式
醫師公布：the doctor announces
調整每天飲食：change／adjust my daily diet
檢查結果：the test results
explain: 主要子句用 will 表未來，as soon as 引導的時間副詞子句用現在簡單式。常見錯誤是在時間子句也加 will；doctor 是單數，因此用 announces。

subject: english
q: 這座博物館的參觀規定以三種語言標示在入口處。
answer: The rules for visiting this museum are posted in three languages at the entrance.
points: 被標示：are posted／displayed
參觀規定：rules for visiting this museum
以三種語言：in three languages
在入口處：at the entrance
explain: 規定是被標示的對象，用 be 加過去分詞。常見錯誤是 rules 為複數卻搭配 is；「以某種語言」用 in，「在入口處」用 at the entrance。

subject: english
q: 那張受損的全家福已經修復，現在掛在客廳裡。
answer: That damaged family photo has been repaired and now hangs in the living room.
points: 已經修復：has been repaired（完成式被動）
那張受損的全家福：that damaged family photo
現在掛在客廳裡：now hangs in the living room
explain: 照片已被修復且結果與現在有關，用 has been repaired。常見錯誤是漏掉 been；photo 是單數，後面並列的 hangs 也須加 s。

subject: english
q: 願意和同學分享筆記的學生，往往也能從討論中學到更多。
answer: Students who are willing to share notes with classmates often learn more from discussions.
points: 願意分享的：who／that are willing to share
筆記給同學：(their) notes with classmates
往往能學更多：often／can often learn more
從討論中：from discussions
explain: 用 who 引導關係子句修飾 Students，也可用 that。常見錯誤是在關係子句多加 they；who 已是主詞，不可寫 who they are willing。

subject: english
q: 連日大雨導致道路封閉，這也影響了當地居民的生活。
answer: Days of heavy rain caused road closures, which also affected the lives of local residents.
points: 這也影響了：, which also affected（非限定關係子句）
連日大雨：days of heavy rain
導致道路封閉：caused road closures
當地居民的生活：the lives of local residents
explain: 逗號後的 which 補充說明前面道路封閉的情況及其影響。常見錯誤是改用 that；非限定關係子句不能用 that。caused 與 affected 都表達過去的事件。

subject: english
q: 這個網站提供一個讓使用者交換二手書的平台。
answer: This website provides a platform where users can exchange used books.
points: 使用者交換的：where／on which users can exchange
網站提供平台：this website provides a platform
二手書：used books／secondhand books
explain: where 引導關係子句，修飾表示活動空間的 platform，也可寫 on which。常見錯誤是寫 where users can exchange used books on，在句尾多加介系詞。

subject: english
q: 運動前吃的東西，可能會影響你在球場上的表現。
answer: What you eat before exercise may affect your performance on the court.
points: 吃的東西：what you eat（名詞子句）
運動前：before exercise／exercising
可能影響你的表現：may affect your performance
在球場上：on the court／field
explain: What you eat 是名詞子句，整體作為主詞，意為「你吃的東西」。常見錯誤是寫 the things what you eat；what 已包含「東西」的意思，不須再加先行詞。

subject: english
q: 報名前，我們想先確認這趟導覽是否包含午餐。
answer: Before signing up, we want to check first whether this guided tour includes lunch.
points: 是否：whether／if + 主詞 + 動詞
報名前：before signing up／registering
想先確認：want to check／confirm (first)
導覽含午餐：this (guided) tour includes lunch
explain: check 後用 whether 引導名詞子句，也可用 if。常見錯誤是沿用疑問句倒裝，寫 whether does the tour include；名詞子句須用主詞在動詞前的語序。

subject: english
q: 哥哥記得我生日這件事，讓我在忙碌的一天後感到溫暖。
answer: The fact that my older brother remembered my birthday warmed my heart after a busy day.
points: 這件事：the fact that …（同位語子句）
記得我生日：remembered my birthday
感到溫暖：warmed my heart
忙碌一天後：after a busy day
explain: that 引導同位語子句，說明 fact 的具體內容，後面接完整的主詞與動詞。常見錯誤是誤用 which；此處 that 不在子句中作主詞或受詞。older brother 明確表示哥哥。

subject: english
q: 每天大聲朗讀課文，有助於學生改善英文發音。
answer: Reading texts aloud every day helps students improve their English pronunciation.
points: 朗讀課文：reading text(s) aloud（動名詞主詞）
每天：every day
有助學生改善：helps students (to) improve
英文發音：their English pronunciation
explain: 動名詞片語 Reading texts aloud every day 當主詞，視為單數，因此用 helps。常見錯誤是把動詞原形 Read 直接放在主詞位置；help 後可接 improve 或 to improve。

subject: english
q: 對當地居民而言，保護這片濕地是很重要的事。
answer: It is important for local residents to protect this wetland.
points: 很重要的事：It is important … to protect（虛主詞）
對當地居民而言：for local residents
這片濕地：this wetland
explain: 用 It 作虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的不定詞片語。常見錯誤是寫 important of local residents；此處說明事情對誰重要，須用 for。

subject: english
q: 這台電腦太老舊，已經無法執行最新的繪圖軟體。
answer: This computer is too old to run the latest drawing software.
points: 太老舊而無法執行：too old to run
這台電腦：this computer
最新的繪圖軟體：the latest drawing software
explain: too 加形容詞再接 to V，表達程度過高而無法做到。常見錯誤是在 to 後再加 not；too old to run 已包含無法執行的意思。software 是不可數名詞。

subject: english
q: 為了睡得更好，我妹妹會避免在睡前喝含糖飲料。
answer: My younger sister avoids drinking sugary drinks before bed to sleep better.
points: 避免喝：avoids drinking（動詞後接動名詞）
妹妹：my (younger) sister
睡前喝含糖飲料：sugary drinks before bed
為了睡得更好：to sleep better
explain: avoid 後接動名詞，所以用 drinking，不能寫 avoids to drink。句尾的 to sleep better 則是不定詞表目的；主詞 My sister 是單數，avoid 要加 s。

subject: english
q: 在機場等候登機的旅客，可以先用手機查看目的地的天氣。
answer: Passengers waiting to board at the airport can first check the weather at their destination on their phones.
points: 等候登機的：waiting to board（現在分詞修飾）
在機場：at the airport
目的地天氣：weather at their destination
先用手機查：first check … on their phones
explain: waiting to board at the airport 是現在分詞片語，修飾主動等候登機的 Passengers。常見錯誤是把 waiting 寫成 waited；也可用 who are waiting to board 改寫。

subject: english
q: 祖母親手做的蛋糕，讓這次家庭聚會多了幾分溫馨。
answer: The cake made by my grandmother added warmth to this family gathering.
points: 祖母做的：made by …／that … made
祖母：my grandmother／grandma
蛋糕增添溫馨：the cake … added warmth
這次家庭聚會：this family gathering
explain: made by my grandmother 是過去分詞片語，修飾被製作的蛋糕。常見錯誤是用 making；蛋糕不是製作動作的執行者。也可寫 the cake that my grandmother made。

subject: english
q: 如果我現在有更多空閒時間，就會加入學校的戲劇社。
answer: If I had more free time now, I would join the school drama club.
points: 如果現在有更多時間：If I had more free time now
就會加入：would join
學校的戲劇社：the school drama club
explain: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句用過去式，主要子句用 would 加原形動詞。常見錯誤是把 if 子句寫成 If I would have；had 在此表示假設，並非過去真的擁有。

subject: english
q: 如果我們上次野餐時有分類垃圾，就能減少送去焚燒的廢棄物。
answer: If we had sorted the trash at our last picnic, we could have reduced the amount of waste sent to be burned.
points: 如果當時有分類：If we had sorted the／our trash
上次野餐時：at our last picnic
就能減少：could／would have reduced
送去焚燒的廢棄物：waste sent to be burned
explain: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had 加過去分詞，主要子句用 could／would have 加過去分詞；could 較強調原本能做到。常見錯誤是寫 could reduced。sent to be burned 是修飾 waste 的過去分詞片語。

subject: english
q: 我真希望當初沒有在未經朋友同意的情況下貼出那張照片。
answer: I wish I had not posted that photo without my friend's permission.
points: 真希望當初沒有貼出：wish I had not posted
那張照片：that photo
未經朋友同意：without my friend's permission
explain: 對過去行為感到後悔，wish 後用過去完成式。常見錯誤是只寫 wish I did not post，無法清楚表達對已發生行為的懊悔；permission 是不可數名詞。

subject: english
q: 他看起來疲憊不堪，彷彿已經好幾天沒有睡覺了。
answer: He looks exhausted, as if he had not slept for days.
points: 彷彿：as if／as though
好幾天沒睡：had／has not slept for days
看來疲憊：looks exhausted／very tired
explain: as if／as though 後可用過去完成式表較早的假設情況；若認為他可能真的沒睡，也可用 has not slept。常見錯誤是把 sleep 的過去分詞寫成 sleeped，正確形式是 slept。

subject: english
q: 地方政府早該修好老街上的路燈，讓夜間通行更安全。
answer: It is time the local government repaired the streetlights on the old street to make it safer to walk there at night.
points: 早該修好：It is (high) time … repaired
地方政府：the local government
老街上的路燈：streetlights on the old street
讓夜間通行更安全：safer to walk … at night
explain: It is time 後接主詞與過去式，表示現在早該做某事，repaired 並非描述已修好。常見錯誤是直接用 repairs；也可用 It is high time，或在 time 後加 that。

subject: english
q: 爸爸建議全家人在晚餐時關掉手機，好好聽彼此說話。
answer: Dad suggested that everyone in the family turn off their phones at dinner and listen carefully to each other.
points: 建議關掉：suggested that … (should) turn off
全家人：everyone in the family／whole family
晚餐時關手機：their phones at dinner
聽彼此：listen … to each other／one another
explain: suggest 表建議時，that 子句用原形動詞，也可加 should。常見錯誤是因 everyone 為單數而寫 turns off；此處須用 turn off，並列的 listen 也用原形。好好聽可用 listen carefully，彼此可用 each other 或 one another。

subject: english
q: 小組報告能順利完成，我們不該把同學的協助視為理所當然。
answer: We should not take our classmates' help in successfully completing the group report for granted.
points: 不該視為理所當然：should not take … for granted
同學的協助：our classmates' help
順利完成：successfully completing／finishing
小組報告：the group report
explain: take … for granted 的受詞放在 take 與 for granted 之間。常見錯誤是漏掉 for。in successfully completing the group report 說明同學協助完成報告；多位同學的所有格寫 classmates'。

subject: english
q: 森林在保護水源方面扮演重要角色，也提供動物棲息地。
answer: Forests play an important role in protecting water sources and provide homes for animals.
points: 扮演重要角色：play an important role in
保護水源：protecting water sources
動物棲息地：provide homes／habitats for animals
explain: play an important role in 後接名詞或動名詞，這裡用 protecting。常見錯誤是寫 in protect；in 是介系詞，後面不能直接接動詞原形。homes 或 habitats 都可表達動物棲息的地方。

subject: english
q: 使用社群媒體時，青少年應該留意個人資料外洩的風險。
answer: Teenagers should be aware of the risk of personal information leaks when using social media.
points: 青少年應留意：teenagers should be aware of
外洩風險：risk of … leaks／being leaked
個人資料：personal information
使用社群媒體時：when using social media
explain: be aware of 表示察覺或留意，should 後須保留 be。常見錯誤是寫 should aware of。when using 的隱含主詞須與主要子句相同，此處都是 Teenagers。

subject: english
q: 除了規律運動，充足的睡眠也有助於維持身體健康。
answer: In addition to regular exercise, enough sleep also helps us stay healthy.
points: 除了：in addition to／besides／as well as
規律運動：regular exercise
充足睡眠：enough／sufficient sleep
有助維持健康：helps us (to) stay healthy
explain: in addition to 表示「除了……之外還有」，to 是介系詞，後接名詞。常見錯誤是因 exercise 與 sleep 都出現而用 help；句子的主詞只有 enough sleep，所以用 helps。

subject: english
q: 室友之間缺乏溝通，導致多次爭吵，影響了彼此的關係。
answer: A lack of communication between the roommates resulted in repeated arguments and hurt their relationship.
points: 導致多次爭吵：resulted in repeated arguments
缺乏溝通：a lack of communication
室友之間：between the roommates
影響彼此關係：hurt their relationship
explain: result in 後接結果，result from 後接原因。常見錯誤是把兩者混用；此處缺乏溝通是原因，爭吵是結果。也可改寫為 Repeated arguments resulted from a lack of communication。

subject: english
q: 父母出差期間，弟弟得靠我準備每天的晚餐。
answer: My younger brother has to rely on me to prepare dinner every day while our parents are away on business.
points: 依靠：rely on／depend on
弟弟得：my younger brother has to
我準備每日晚餐：me to prepare dinner every day
父母出差期間：while … are away on business
explain: rely on someone to V 表示依靠某人做某事，也可用 depend on。常見錯誤是漏掉 on，直接寫 rely me。on business 是「出差」，younger brother 指弟弟。

subject: english
q: 明天雨一停，教練就會帶我們到操場練習。
answer: As soon as the rain stops tomorrow, the coach will take us to the sports field to practice.
points: 雨一停：as soon as the rain stops
明天：tomorrow
教練就會帶我們：the coach will take us
到操場練習：to … field to practice
explain: 表示未來的時間副詞子句用現在式，主要子句才用 will 加原形動詞。常見錯誤是在 as soon as 後也使用 will。

subject: english
q: 這份社區安全報告每年都由當地居民共同完成。
answer: This report on community safety is jointly prepared by local residents every year.
points: 完成：is … prepared／completed（被動）
社區安全報告：report on community safety
居民共同：local residents；jointly／together
每年：every year
explain: 報告是被完成的對象，用 is prepared 或 is completed，執行者放在 by 後。jointly 或 together 表示共同；community safety report 也可。every year 表示例行事件，別漏掉被動語態的 be 動詞。

subject: english
q: 這本介紹臺灣傳統藝術的書已經在海外出版。
answer: This book about traditional art in Taiwan has been published overseas.
points: 已經出版：has (already) been published
介紹傳統藝術的書：book about traditional … art
臺灣的：Taiwanese／in Taiwan
在海外：overseas／abroad
explain: 出版已完成且與現在有關，用現在完成式被動 has been published；already 可省略。常見錯誤是只寫 has published，變成書主動出版。traditional Taiwanese art 與 traditional art in Taiwan 均可。

subject: english
q: 所有費用都應該由網路商店在付款前清楚列出。
answer: All fees should be clearly listed by online stores before payment.
points: 應該列出：should be … listed
所有費用：all fees／all charges
網路商店清楚列出：clearly；by online stores
付款前：before payment／before customers pay
explain: 費用是被列出的對象，用 should be 加過去分詞 listed；副詞 clearly 可放在 be 與 listed 之間。常見錯誤是寫成 should listed，漏掉 be。付款前也可譯為 before customers pay。

subject: english
q: 車站前的道路目前正在維修，公車因此改道。
answer: The road in front of the station is being repaired, so buses are taking a different route.
points: 正在維修：is being repaired
車站前的道路：the road in front of the station
因此：so
公車改道：buses are taking a different route
explain: 道路正在被維修，用 is being repaired。常見錯誤是省略 being，變成一般現在式被動，無法表達目前正在進行。

subject: english
q: 她以前常在週末送餐，現在則負責訓練新志工。
answer: She used to deliver meals on weekends, but now she is in charge of training new volunteers.
points: 以前常送餐：used to deliver meals
週末：on weekends／at weekends
現在負責：now；in charge of／responsible for
訓練新志工：training new volunteers
explain: used to 加原形動詞表示過去的習慣，和現在的工作形成對比。不要寫成 is used to deliver；be used to 後接名詞或動名詞，表示習慣於。

subject: english
q: 這次登山經驗教會我的事，比我原先預期的更多。
answer: What this hiking experience taught me was more than I had expected.
points: 教會我的事：what … taught me
這次登山經驗：this hiking experience
比預期更多：was more than I (had) expected
explain: what 子句表示「……的事」，整個子句作主詞，搭配單數動詞 was。常見錯誤是改用 that，因為 taught me 後仍缺少所教的內容。

subject: english
q: 居民想知道這座公共游泳池明年是否會重新開放。
answer: Residents want to know whether the public swimming pool will reopen next year.
points: 是否會重新開放：whether／if … will reopen
居民想知道：residents want to know
這座公共泳池：the／this public swimming pool
明年：next year
explain: whether 引導間接問句，也可用 if。子句要用主詞在助動詞前的直述句語序，常見錯誤是寫成 whether will the pool reopen。

subject: english
q: 紙本書仍然受到歡迎這件事，讓這位作家感到驚訝。
answer: The fact that printed books are still popular surprises this writer.
points: 這件事：the fact that（同位語子句）
紙本書仍受歡迎：printed books are still popular
讓作家驚訝：surprises／surprised … writer
explain: that 子句補充 fact 的內容，子句本身結構完整。主詞是單數 fact，若用現在式，動詞須用 surprises，不能受 books 影響寫成 surprise；若敘述過去的反應，用 surprised 也可。

subject: english
q: 雖然這件外套正在特價，她仍決定先比較其他店的價格。
answer: Although this coat was on sale, she still decided to compare prices at other stores first.
points: 雖然：although／even though
這件外套特價：this coat is／was on sale
仍決定先比較：still decides／decided … first
其他店的價格：compare prices at other stores
explain: although 引導讓步子句，主要子句可保留 still。敘述已做的決定可用 was、decided；描述眼前情況也可用 is、decides。常見錯誤是同時使用 although 和 but。

subject: english
q: 昨晚的霧太濃了，以致駕駛幾乎看不見前方的路。
answer: The fog was so thick last night that drivers could hardly see the road ahead.
points: 太濃以致：so thick … that／such … fog that
昨晚的霧：fog；last night
駕駛幾乎看不見：drivers could hardly／barely see
前方的路：the road ahead
explain: so 加形容詞再接 that 子句，表達程度造成的結果。常見錯誤是寫成 so thick fog；若改用 such，應寫 such thick fog that。

subject: english
q: 這群志工不僅清理海灘，也向遊客介紹海洋生物。
answer: These volunteers not only clean up beaches but also tell visitors about marine life.
points: 不僅也：not only … but also
這群志工：these volunteers
清理海灘：clean (up) the beach／beaches
介紹海洋生物：tell visitors about marine life
explain: not only 與 but also 後接平行結構，此處都是動詞片語；不能把後半改成 introducing，與 clean 不平行。介紹也可用 introduce marine life to visitors，清理可用 clean 或 clean up。

subject: english
q: 為了避免受傷，球員在每次練習前都會先暖身。
answer: To avoid getting hurt, players warm up before every practice.
points: 避免受傷：avoid getting／being hurt／injured
為了：to（表目的）
球員暖身：players warm up
每次練習前：before every／each practice
explain: avoid 後接動名詞，受傷可用 getting hurt。常見錯誤是寫成 avoid to get hurt；句首的 to 是表示目的，和 avoid 後的形式不同。

subject: english
q: 在街角排隊的民眾正等著領取免費的健康檢查號碼牌。
answer: People standing in line at the street corner are waiting to get numbered tickets for free health checks.
points: 排隊的民眾：people standing in line／lining up
在街角：at the street corner
領號碼牌：are waiting to get numbered tickets
免費健康檢查：free health checks
explain: standing in line 或 lining up 是現在分詞片語，修飾主動排隊的 people；也可用 who are standing in line。numbered tickets 表示號碼牌。常見錯誤是漏掉主句的 are，使 waiting 缺少助動詞。

subject: english
q: 學生們在美術課完成的作品，下週將在圖書館展出。
answer: The works completed by students in art class will be displayed in the library next week.
points: 完成的作品：works completed／works … completed
學生在美術課：students；in art class
將展出：will be displayed／shown
下週在圖書館：in／at the library；next week
explain: completed 是過去分詞，作品是被學生完成的；不能用表示主動的 completing。第一點也接受 works (that) students completed，students 前加 the 亦可。展出可用 be displayed 或 be shown。

subject: english
q: 仔細比較價格後，她選了一台符合預算的二手電腦。
answer: Having carefully compared prices, she chose a used computer that fit her budget.
points: 比較後：having … compared／after comparing
仔細比較價格：carefully；prices
她選二手電腦：she chose a used computer
符合預算：that fit／was within her budget
explain: Having compared 表示比較先於選購，分詞構句的隱含主詞須與 she 相同；after comparing 或 after she compared 也可。carefully 可放在 compared 前或 prices 後。常見錯誤是省掉 having 卻寫 Compared，誤成被動。

subject: english
q: 由於部分觀眾仍在交談，演員只好暫停演出。
answer: With some audience members still talking, the actors had to pause the performance.
points: 觀眾仍在交談：with … still talking
部分觀眾：some audience members
演員只好：actors had to／had no choice but to
暫停演出：pause／stop … performance
explain: with 加受詞再接分詞，可交代主要動作的背景；觀眾主動交談，所以用 talking。常見錯誤是寫成 with some audience members still talked。只好也可用 had no choice but to。

subject: english
q: 活動開始前，負責人讓每位志工再次確認自己的工作。
answer: Before the event began, the person in charge had each volunteer check their own duties again.
points: 讓志工確認：had／made／let each volunteer check
活動開始前：before the event began／begins
負責人：the person in charge／the leader
再次確認工作：check their own duties again
explain: had each volunteer check 表示安排每位志工確認工作，check 前不加 to。若強調要求或允許，也可用 made 或 let；敘述例行安排可用現在式 have。each volunteer 可用 their 指稱，其工作也可用 tasks。

subject: english
q: 他只是第一次學衝浪，說起話來卻像是經驗豐富的教練。
answer: He is learning to surf for the first time, but he talks as if he were an experienced coach.
points: 彷彿是：as if／as though he were／was
初學衝浪：learning to surf for the first time
他說起話來卻：but he talks
經驗豐富的教練：an experienced coach
explain: as if 後用 were 表示與現在事實相反：他其實不是教練。常見錯誤是用 had been，誤把現在的假設寫成對過去的假設；口語用 was 也可。

subject: english
q: 我們該正視網路霸凌對青少年心理健康的影響了。
answer: It is time we faced the effects of online bullying on teenagers' mental health.
points: 該正視了：it is time … faced／for us to face
影響：effects／impact … on
網路霸凌：online bullying／cyberbullying
青少年心理健康：teenagers' mental health
explain: It is time 後接子句時，用過去式表達現在早該做的事；常見錯誤是寫成 we face。第一點也接受 It is time for us to face；online bullying 可用 cyberbullying。effects 或 impact 後接 on，表示對……的影響。

subject: english
q: 閱讀社的成員建議學校在午休時開放閱讀空間。
answer: Members of the reading club suggested that the school open a reading space during the lunch break.
points: 建議學校開放：suggested … school (should) open
閱讀社成員：members of the reading club
閱讀空間：a reading space
午休時：during the lunch break
explain: suggest 表示建議時，that 子句用原形動詞 open，也可用 should open。常見錯誤是因主詞 school 為單數而寫成 opens，或隨 suggested 改成 opened。

subject: english
q: 直到收到帳單，他才發現自己上個月花了多少錢。
answer: Not until he received the bill did he realize how much money he had spent the previous month.
points: 直到才：not until … did he realize
收到帳單：he received the bill
花了多少錢：how much money he (had) spent
上個月：the previous month／last month
explain: Not until 放句首時，主要子句用 did 加主詞與原形動詞，until 子句不倒裝。間接問句 how much … 用直述句語序。had spent 清楚標示花錢在發現之前；時間先後明確時也可用 spent。

subject: english
q: 只有改善轉乘服務，我們才能吸引更多人搭乘大眾運輸。
answer: Only by improving transfer services can we attract more people to public transportation.
points: 只有改善才能：only by improving … can we
轉乘服務：transfer services
吸引更多人：attract／encourage more people
大眾運輸：public transportation
explain: Only 加方式片語放句首，主要子句須把 can 放在 we 前，不能仍寫 we can。by 後接 improving。吸引更多人搭乘也可寫 encourage more people to use public transportation，末項接受此寫法。

subject: english
q: 正是鄰居們長期的支持，讓這個課後陪讀計畫得以延續。
answer: It is the neighbors' long-term support that keeps this after-school tutoring program going.
points: 正是支持：it is … support that …
鄰居們長期的：the neighbors' long-term
課後陪讀計畫：after-school tutoring program
得以延續：keeps／has kept … going
explain: It is … that … 強調使計畫延續的支持。support 是不可數名詞，現在式用 keeps，不可受 neighbors 影響寫成 keep；若強調一路延續至今，可用 has kept。tutoring program 表示提供學習協助的計畫。

subject: english
q: 除了出租運動器材，這座運動中心也提供初學者課程。
answer: In addition to renting out sports equipment, this sports center offers classes for beginners.
points: 除了：in addition to／as well as
出租運動器材：renting out sports equipment
這座運動中心：this sports center
提供初學者課程：offers classes for beginners
explain: in addition to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 renting，不能接原形 rent；也可用 As well as renting out …。rent out 表示出租，equipment 不可數，不能加 s；offers 可用 provides。

subject: english
q: 長期缺乏睡眠可能導致注意力下降，進而影響工作表現。
answer: A long-term lack of sleep may result in reduced concentration and thus affect work performance.
points: 可能導致：may／can result in
長期缺乏睡眠：a long-term lack of sleep
注意力下降：reduced concentration／attention
進而影響工作表現：thus／in turn；work performance
explain: result in 後接結果，result from 後接原因，勿混淆方向。reduced concentration 表示專注力下降。末項須有 affect work performance（也可用 job performance）；and thus affect 可改為 which in turn affects，均表示進而影響。

subject: english
q: 小型劇團往往仰賴觀眾購票，才能支付演出的費用。
answer: Small theater groups often rely on ticket sales to cover the costs of their performances.
points: 仰賴：rely on／depend on
小型劇團往往：small theater groups often
觀眾購票：ticket sales
支付演出費用：cover the costs of performances
explain: rely on 表示依靠，on 後接名詞 ticket sales，再用 to cover 說明用途。常見錯誤是省略 on；此處 cover costs 是支付費用的自然搭配。

subject: english
q: 為了存錢買腳踏車，他努力減少不必要的日常開銷。
answer: To save up for a bicycle, he makes an effort to cut unnecessary daily expenses.
points: 努力減少：makes an effort to cut
為了存錢買腳踏車：to save up for a bicycle
不必要的日常開銷：unnecessary daily expenses
explain: make an effort to 後接原形動詞，表示努力做某事。常見錯誤是漏掉 an；save up for 加目標物，表示為購買該物而存錢。

subject: english
q: 為了跟上城市的變化，市府每年都會更新大眾運輸路線圖。
answer: To keep up with changes in the city, the city government updates its transit map every year.
points: 跟上變化：keep up with changes
城市的：in the city
市府更新路線圖：city government updates … map
每年：every year
explain: keep up with 表示持續跟上變化，with 不能省略。catch up with 較強調從落後到追上。transit map 指大眾運輸路線圖，也可用 public transportation map；更新可用現在式，表達每年的例行工作。

subject: english
q: 透過社區志工的協助，偏鄉長者也能取得所需的醫療資訊。
answer: With help from community volunteers, older people in remote areas can also have access to the medical information they need.
points: 也能取得：can also have access to
透過協助：with help from community volunteers
偏鄉長者：older people in remote areas
所需醫療資訊：the medical information they need
explain: have access to 表示能取得或使用，to 後接名詞。常見錯誤是把 information 寫成 informations；information 是不可數名詞，所需資訊可用 they need 修飾。

subject: english
q: 年輕人的職涯選擇應該受到尊重，而不是由父母決定。
answer: Young people's career choices should be respected rather than decided by their parents.
points: 應該受到尊重：should be respected
年輕人的職涯選擇：young people's career choices
非父母決定：rather than ... by their parents
explain: 「應該被……」用 should be 加過去分詞，不能漏掉 be；rather than 後省略重複的 be，仍用過去分詞 decided。

subject: english
q: 通往賞鳥區的步道正在整修，遊客暫時無法進入。
answer: The trail to the birdwatching area is being repaired, so visitors cannot enter for now.
points: 正在整修：is being repaired
通往賞鳥區的步道：trail to the birdwatching area
遊客暫時無法進入：visitors cannot enter for now
explain: 步道是被整修的對象，且工程正在進行，用 is being repaired；不可寫成 is repairing，否則變成步道主動修理東西。

subject: english
q: 祖母以前常在過年前做年糕，現在卻習慣到市場買。
answer: Grandma used to make rice cakes before Chinese New Year, but now she is used to buying them at the market.
points: 以前常做年糕：used to make rice cakes
過年前：before Chinese New Year
現在習慣買：is used to buying them
到市場：at the market
explain: used to 加原形動詞表示過去的習慣；be used to 的 to 是介系詞，後接動名詞，因此要寫 buying，不能寫 buy。

subject: english
q: 編輯打電話來時，我正在查證那張網路照片的來源。
answer: I was checking the source of that online photo when the editor called.
points: 正在查證時：was checking ... when
那張網路照片的來源：source of that online photo
編輯打電話來：the editor called
explain: 過去進行式表示當時正在查證，when 引導打電話這個插入的事件；called 用過去簡單式，不要把兩個動作都寫成現在式。

subject: english
q: 等到高中畢業時，她將已經克服在眾人面前說話的恐懼。
answer: By the time she graduates from high school, she will have overcome her fear of speaking in public.
points: 將已經克服：will have overcome
等到畢業時：by the time she graduates
高中：from high school
公開說話的恐懼：fear of speaking in public
explain: 未來某時之前已完成的事用 will have 加過去分詞；by the time 引導的時間子句用現在式 graduates，不用 will graduate。

subject: english
q: 自從實驗室買了新的顯微鏡以來，已經過了三個月。
answer: It has been three months since the laboratory bought a new microscope.
points: 自從至今已三個月：It has been three months since
實驗室：the laboratory
買了新的顯微鏡：bought a new microscope
explain: 「自從……以來已經多久」可用 It has been 加時間再接 since 子句；since 後描述已發生的購買事件，用 bought，不能用 buy。

subject: english
q: 雖然這份工作的薪水比較低，他仍選擇做自己有興趣的事。
answer: Although this job pays less, he still chooses to do what interests him.
points: 雖然：although／even though
薪水較低：pays／paid less
仍選擇做：still chooses／chose to do
有興趣的事：what interests／interested him
explain: although 引導讓步子句，主要子句不再加 but；what interests him 表示他感興趣的事。中文未限定時間，也可整句採過去式 paid、chose、interested，時態與語境須一致。

subject: english
q: 昨晚的暴風雨如此猛烈，以致河邊好幾個鳥巢都被摧毀了。
answer: The storm last night was so strong that several nests by the river were destroyed.
points: 如此猛烈以致：so strong that
昨晚的暴風雨：the storm last night
河邊鳥巢：nests／bird nests by the river
好幾個被摧毀：several ... were destroyed
explain: so 後接形容詞 strong，再用 that 帶出結果；nests 是複數且承受破壞，應寫 were destroyed，不能寫 was destroyed。

subject: english
q: 透過聽長輩說故事，孩子不僅了解傳統，也學會尊重不同世代。
answer: By listening to elders' stories, children not only learn about traditions but also learn to respect different generations.
points: 不僅也：not only ... but also
聽長輩故事：by listening to elders' stories
了解傳統：learn about traditions
尊重不同世代：respect different generations
explain: not only 與 but also 連接平行的動詞片語，這裡都以 learn 開頭；by 後接動名詞 listening。聽長輩說故事也可寫 listening to elders tell stories；長輩可用 elders 或 their elders。

subject: english
q: 只要先確認消息來源可靠，你就可以把這則新聞分享給同學。
answer: As long as you first make sure the source is reliable, you can share this news with your classmates.
points: 只要：as long as
先確認來源可靠：first make sure ... is reliable
分享新聞：share this news／this news story
給同學：with your classmates
explain: as long as 引導條件子句，表示只要符合條件即可；news 是不可數名詞，可寫 this news，也可用可數的 this news story；不可寫 these news 或 a news。

subject: english
q: 無論面試時多麼緊張，他都會先深呼吸，讓自己平靜下來。
answer: No matter how nervous he feels during an interview, he first takes a deep breath to calm himself down.
points: 無論多緊張：no matter how／however nervous
面試時：during／in an interview
先深呼吸：first takes a deep breath
讓自己平靜下來：to calm himself down
explain: no matter how 或 however 後接形容詞，再接主詞與動詞，如 however nervous he feels；也可用 he is。不可倒裝成 how nervous does he feel；「先」用 first。

subject: english
q: 科學家用簡單的文字解釋新發現，好讓一般民眾也能理解。
answer: Scientists explain new findings in simple words so that the public can understand them too.
points: 好讓：so that／in order that
科學家解釋新發現：scientists explain new findings
用簡單的文字：in simple words
民眾也懂：the public can understand them too
explain: so that 或 in order that 引導目的子句，後接主詞與 can 加原形動詞。them 指複數 findings；「也」可用 too 或 also，如 the public can also understand them。

subject: english
q: 希望能幫助更多病人，她決定在大學主修護理。
answer: Hoping to help more patients, she decided to major in nursing in college.
points: 希望能幫助：Hoping to help（分詞構句）
更多病人：more patients
決定主修護理：decided to major in nursing
在大學：in college
explain: 句首的 Hoping 由 she 主動發出，分詞構句與主要子句必須共用主詞；不可改成 Hoped。major in 後接主修的科目。

subject: english
q: 隨著樹葉一片片飄落，這座森林逐漸換上金黃色的面貌。
answer: With leaves falling one by one, the forest is gradually turning golden.
points: 隨著樹葉飄落：with leaves falling
一片片：one by one
森林逐漸變金黃：is gradually turning golden
explain: with 後接受詞 leaves 與現在分詞 falling，表示葉子主動飄落；不要寫成 with leaves fall，因為這裡不是完整子句。

subject: english
q: 為了準備下週的傳統儀式，村民請人修好了那面老鼓。
answer: To prepare for next week's traditional ceremony, the villagers had the old drum repaired.
points: 請人修好鼓：had the old drum repaired
為了準備：to prepare for
下週傳統儀式：next week's traditional ceremony
村民：the villagers
explain: have 加物品再接過去分詞表示請人處理某物；鼓被修理，用 repaired，不可用 repair。也可寫 had someone repair the old drum，have 加人後接原形動詞。

subject: english
q: 打開收音機時，我聽見主持人正在解釋那則新聞的背景。
answer: When I turned on the radio, I heard the host explaining the background of that news story.
points: 聽見主持人解釋：heard the host explain(ing)
打開收音機時：when I turned on the radio
背景：background of that news story／report
explain: hear 加受詞再接現在分詞，強調正在進行的動作；不可寫 heard the host to explain。原形 explain 強調整個過程，若語境成立也可；主持人可寫 the host 或 the presenter。

subject: english
q: 她每天晚上花十分鐘記下感恩的事，藉此減輕心中的焦慮。
answer: She spends ten minutes every evening writing down things she is grateful for to ease her anxiety.
points: 花時間記下：spends ... writing down
每晚十分鐘：ten minutes every／each evening
感恩的事：things she is grateful for
減輕焦慮：to ease／reduce her anxiety
explain: spend 加時間後接動名詞 writing，不能用 to write；things she is grateful for 中的 for 不可省略，因為 grateful 要搭配 for。

subject: english
q: 學生藉由比較兩組植物，發現溫度會影響它們的生長速度。
answer: By comparing two groups of plants, the students found that temperature affected how fast they grew.
points: 藉由比較：by comparing
兩組植物：two groups of plants
發現溫度影響：found ... affected／affects
生長速度：how fast they grew／grow
explain: by 是介系詞，後接 comparing，不用 compare；敘述過去觀察可用 affected、grew。若強調仍成立的一般現象，也可保留現在式 affects、grow；生長速度也可寫 their growth rate。

subject: english
q: 即使學習過程並不順利，我也從未考慮放棄成為廚師的夢想。
answer: Never have I considered giving up my dream of becoming a chef, even though learning has been difficult.
points: 從未考慮：Never have I considered（倒裝）
放棄夢想：giving up my dream
成為廚師：of becoming a chef
即使學習不順：even though ... difficult／hard
explain: Never 放句首時，have 移到 I 前，considered 用過去分詞；consider 後接 giving，不用 to give。「學習不順」可用 learning has been difficult／hard；即使也可用 even when。

subject: english
q: 只有在太陽下山之後，這些蝙蝠才會離開洞穴尋找食物。
answer: Only after the sun sets do these bats leave the cave to look for food.
points: 只有日落後才：Only after ... do（倒裝）
太陽下山：the sun sets／sunset
蝙蝠離開洞穴：these bats leave the cave
尋找食物：to look for food
explain: Only 加時間片語或子句放句首，主要子句用 do 加主詞再接原形 leave；after 可接 sunset，也可接 the sun sets，時間子句本身維持一般語序。

subject: english
q: 每年都是祖父教我們製作燈籠，讓這項手藝得以傳承。
answer: It is our grandfather that teaches us to make lanterns every year, helping to pass down this skill.
points: 是祖父教：It is ... that／who teaches
祖父教我們：our grandfather ... us
每年製作燈籠：make lanterns every year
傳承手藝：pass down this skill／craft
explain: It is ... that ... 強調教導者；強調人也可用 who。grandfather 是單數，動詞用 teaches。helping to ... 表示促成的結果；也可寫 so that this skill can be passed down。

subject: english
q: 如果沒有可信的報導，一般民眾就無法了解這起事件的真相。
answer: Without reliable reports, the public could not learn the truth about this event.
points: 如果沒有：without／but for（假設）
無法：could not／would not be able to learn
可信的報導：reliable reports
事件真相：the truth about this event／incident
explain: without 或 but for 可表示假設條件，主要子句可用 could not learn 或 would not be able to learn；情態助動詞後接原形動詞，不能寫 could not learned。

subject: english
q: 妹妹在考試前常常緊張，我也有同樣的情況。
answer: My younger sister often feels nervous before exams, and so do I.
points: 我也如此：so do I／so am I（依前句動詞）
妹妹：my younger sister
常緊張：often feels／gets／is nervous
考試前：before exams
explain: so 加助動詞加主詞表示另一人也有同樣情況；前句用 feels 或 gets nervous，後句用 so do I；前句若用 is nervous，後句則用 so am I，須依動詞搭配。

subject: english
q: 在這門科學課中，這項實驗比其他任何一項實驗都更耗時。
answer: This experiment takes more time than any other experiment in this science course.
points: 更耗時：more time than any other experiment
這項實驗耗費：this experiment takes
在這門科學課中：in this science course
explain: than any other 加單數名詞，表示同一範圍中比其餘每一個都更耗時；other 不可漏掉，否則比較對象會包含自己。

subject: english
q: 為了實現到海外工作的夢想，他努力尋找適合自己的機會。
answer: To achieve his dream of working abroad, he makes an effort to find opportunities that suit him.
points: 努力尋找：makes an effort to find
實現夢想：achieve／realize his dream
到海外工作：of working abroad
適合的機會：opportunities that suit him
explain: make an effort to 後接原形 find，effort 前的 an 不可漏掉；opportunities 是複數，修飾它的關係子句用 suit，不用 suits。

subject: english
q: 那隻受傷的雁飛得太慢，無法追上正往南飛的雁群。
answer: The injured goose flies too slowly to catch up with the flock heading south.
points: 追上雁群：catch up with the flock
受傷的雁：the injured goose
太慢而無法：flies／is flying too slowly to
正往南飛：heading／flying south
explain: catch up with 表示追上，不能漏掉 with；too 加副詞再接 to V，表示慢到無法追上，不必再加 not。

subject: english
q: 透過圖書館的數位資料，學生能取得有關傳統節慶的資訊。
answer: Through the library's digital resources, students have access to information about traditional festivals.
points: 能取得資訊：have access to information
透過圖書館的：through the library's
數位資料：digital resources／materials
有關傳統節慶：about traditional festivals
explain: have access to 表示能取得或使用，access 在此是名詞，不加 an；information 不可數，不要寫成 informations。

subject: english
q: 我們應該先讀完整篇報導，而不是只憑標題就下判斷。
answer: We should read the whole report first instead of judging it by the headline alone.
points: 而非：instead of judging／rather than judge
應先讀全文：should read the whole report first
只憑標題：by the headline alone
explain: instead of 的 of 是介系詞，後接 judging；也可用 rather than judge，judge 與 should 後的 read 保持原形。先讀全文也可寫 read the entire report first。

subject: english
q: 多虧朋友在我失敗後不斷鼓勵，我才逐漸恢復了信心。
answer: Thanks to my friends' constant encouragement after my failure, I gradually regained my confidence.
points: 多虧：thanks to
朋友持續鼓勵：friends' constant encouragement
在我失敗後：after my failure
逐漸恢復信心：gradually regained my confidence
explain: thanks to 後接名詞片語，不能直接接完整子句；friends 是複數，其所有格的撇號放在 s 後，表示多位朋友的鼓勵。

subject: english
q: 這群學生想出了一種簡單的方法，能測量校園內的空氣汙染。
answer: These students came up with a simple way to measure air pollution on campus.
points: 想出方法：came up with a simple way
這群學生：these students
測量校園空氣汙染：measure air pollution on campus
explain: come up with 表示想出，描述已完成的事用 came，不能漏掉 with；way 後可接 to measure，說明這個方法的用途。

subject: english
q: 記者抵達農場時，農夫們正在把蔬菜裝進箱子裡。
answer: The farmers were packing vegetables into boxes when the reporter arrived at the farm.
points: 正在裝箱時：were packing … when …
把蔬菜裝進箱子：vegetables into boxes
記者抵達：the reporter arrived
抵達農場：arrived at the farm
explain: 正在進行的過去動作用 were packing，when 引出後來發生的抵達事件。農夫是複數，不能用 was；when 子句用一般過去式。

subject: english
q: 到明天中午，消防員就會清除完道路上所有倒下的樹木。
answer: By noon tomorrow, the firefighters will have removed all the fallen trees from the roads.
points: 將已清除：will have removed／cleared
到明天中午：by noon tomorrow
消防員：the firefighters
道路上所有倒木：all the fallen trees from …
explain: by noon tomorrow 表示未來的完成期限，因此用 will have removed。will 後接 have，不能依主詞人數改成 has；remove 後可接 from the roads。

subject: english
q: 這座傳統市場重新開放至今，已經過了三年。
answer: It has been three years since this traditional market reopened.
points: 至今已過三年：It has been three years since
這座傳統市場：this traditional market
重新開放：reopened
explain: It has been 加一段時間，再用 since 引出過去的起點。重新開放是三年前完成的事件，所以用 reopened，不能用 reopens。

subject: english
q: 自從加入國際筆友社團以來，我已經交到好幾位外國朋友。
answer: I have made several foreign friends since I joined the international pen pal club.
points: 已交到：have made … since（現在完成式）
加入以來：since I joined／since joining
好幾位外國朋友：several foreign friends
國際筆友社團：the international pen pal club
explain: 主句用現在完成式 have made，since 子句用過去式 joined 交代起點。兩邊主詞同為 I，也可用 since joining；不能用 for 取代接事件起點的 since。

subject: english
q: 那年開學前，她就已經安排好第一週的讀書進度。
answer: She had already planned her study schedule for the first week before school started that year.
points: 就已安排好：had already planned（過去完成式）
第一週進度：study schedule for the first week
開學前：before school started
那年：that year
explain: 安排進度早於過去的開學時間，用 had planned 表示先發生的動作。had 後接過去分詞，不能寫 had plan；開學可用 school started。

subject: english
q: 過去一個月，我們一直在研究減少校園用電的方法。
answer: We have been studying ways to reduce electricity use on campus for the past month.
points: 一直研究：have been studying／researching
減少用電的方法：ways to reduce electricity use
在校園：on campus
過去一個月：for the past month
explain: have been studying 強調研究從過去持續到現在。表示持續一個月要用 for，不能寫 since the past month；ways 後可接 to reduce 說明方法的用途。

subject: english
q: 只要把牛奶放在冰箱裡，就能讓它保鮮更久。
answer: As long as you keep milk in the refrigerator, it will stay fresh longer.
points: 只要：as long as
把牛奶放在冰箱裡：keep milk in the refrigerator
保鮮更久：stay fresh／keep it fresh（加 longer）
explain: as long as 引出條件，本句用現在式 keep；主句可用 will stay fresh longer，或 you can keep it fresh longer。fresh 是形容詞，不要寫成 freshly。

subject: english
q: 無論情況多麼緊急，救援人員都必須保持冷靜。
answer: No matter how urgent the situation is, rescue workers must remain calm.
points: 無論多麼緊急：no matter how／however urgent
情況：the situation is
救援人員：rescue workers
必須保持冷靜：must remain／keep／stay calm
explain: no matter how 後接形容詞，再接主詞與動詞，不能寫成問句語序 how urgent is the situation。也可用 However urgent the situation is 開頭。

subject: english
q: 廟方在路口設置標示，讓遊客能輕鬆找到入口。
answer: The temple put up signs at the intersection so that visitors could easily find the entrance.
points: 讓…能：so that／in order that … could
廟方設置標示：the temple put up signs
在路口：at the intersection
輕鬆找到入口：easily find the entrance
explain: so that 加完整子句表目的；主句用過去式 put，子句配合用 could。不能把 so that 後面直接接原形動詞，必須寫出 visitors 這個主詞。

subject: english
q: 我們越常閱讀國際新聞，就越能了解不同文化。
answer: The more often we read international news, the better we can understand different cultures.
points: 越常就越了解：the more often …, the better …
閱讀國際新聞：read international news
了解不同文化：understand different cultures
explain: 兩個 the 加比較級的子句表示連動變化；常用 more often，了解得更好用 better。news 是不可數名詞，不能在字尾再加 s。

subject: english
q: 哥哥和我都不會在考試前一晚熬夜準備功課。
answer: Neither my older brother nor I stay up late to study the night before an exam.
points: 哥哥和我都不：neither my older brother nor I
熬夜讀書：stay up late to study／studying
考試前一天晚上：the night before an exam
explain: neither A nor B 表示兩者都不，不能再加 not。動詞依較近的主詞 I 使用 stay；stay up late 是熬夜，準備功課可用 to study。

subject: english
q: 含有貴重金屬的舊手機不應該被隨意丟棄。
answer: Old phones that contain valuable metals should not be thrown away carelessly.
points: 含有的：that／which contain（關係子句）
舊手機：old phones／old cell phones
貴重金屬：valuable／precious metals
勿亂丟：should not be thrown away carelessly
explain: that 引導子句修飾 phones，也可用 which。phones 是複數，關係子句用 contain，不能加 s；手機是被丟棄的對象，因此用被動語態。

subject: english
q: 昨天下午，我看見奶奶在陽臺上曬自己種的水果。
answer: Yesterday afternoon, I saw my grandmother drying her home-grown fruit on the balcony.
points: 看見奶奶曬：saw my grandmother dry／drying
自種果：fruit she had grown／home-grown fruit
昨天下午：yesterday afternoon
在陽臺上：on the balcony
explain: see 加受詞與 V-ing 表示看見正在進行的動作，原形 dry 則偏重完整過程；不能寫 saw my grandmother to dry。自己種的水果也可寫 her home-grown fruit。

subject: english
q: 大雨過後，救難隊很難在山區找到安全的路線。
answer: After the heavy rain, the rescue team had difficulty finding a safe route in the mountains.
points: 很難找到：had difficulty／trouble finding
大雨過後：after the heavy rain
救難隊：the rescue team
山區的安全路線：a safe route in the mountains
explain: have difficulty 後接 V-ing，因此「找到」寫 finding，不能接 to find。difficulty 在此表示困難，通常不加 a；山區可用 in the mountains。

subject: english
q: 在夜市，消費者可以透過掃描條碼來支付餐費。
answer: At night markets, customers can pay for their meals by scanning a barcode.
points: 透過掃描條碼：by scanning a barcode
在夜市：at night markets
消費者：customers
支付餐費：pay for their meals
explain: by 加 V-ing 表示方法，不能寫 by scan 或 by to scan。pay for 加購買的物品；若只寫 pay their meals，就少了介系詞 for。

subject: english
q: 這部介紹臺灣茶葉的紀錄片值得全家一起觀賞。
answer: This documentary about Taiwanese tea is worth watching with the whole family.
points: 值得觀賞：is worth watching
這部紀錄片：this documentary
介紹臺灣茶葉：about Taiwanese tea
全家一起：with the whole family
explain: be worth 後接 V-ing，不能寫 worth to watch。紀錄片雖是被觀賞的對象，這裡仍慣用 watching 表達被動意義；with the whole family 表示和全家人一起觀賞。

subject: english
q: 為了在晚餐前完成報告，他讀書前先把手機關機。
answer: In order to finish his report before dinner, he turns off his phone before studying.
points: 為了完成：in order to finish／to finish
晚餐前完成報告：finish his report before dinner
關手機：turns／turned off his phone
讀書前：before studying
explain: in order to 加原形動詞表目的，也可直接用 to finish，不能寫 in order to finishing。before studying 也可寫 before he studies；中文未限定時間，整句改用過去式亦可。

subject: english
q: 離開教室時隨手關燈，可以節省能源並降低電費。
answer: Turning off the lights when leaving the classroom can save energy and lower electricity bills.
points: 關燈這件事：turning off the lights（動名詞當主詞）
離開教室時：when leaving／when you leave …
節省能源：save energy
降低電費：lower／reduce electricity bills
explain: Turning off the lights 整組作主詞，不能用原形 Turn 直接開頭充當主詞。can 後的 save 與 lower 並列，都用原形動詞。

subject: english
q: 要不是學校有供應午餐，有些學生下午就會餓肚子。
answer: Without the lunches provided by the school, some students would go hungry in the afternoon.
points: 若沒有就會：without／but for … would go
供餐：school lunches／lunches provided by …
有些學生挨餓：some students would go hungry
在下午：in the afternoon
explain: without 在此表示與現況相反的條件，主句用 would 加原形動詞。provided 修飾 lunches，表示午餐由學校供應，不可改成主動的 providing。

subject: english
q: 姊姊從不在颱風天獨自出門，我也一樣。
answer: My older sister never goes out alone during typhoons, and neither do I.
points: 我也不：neither／nor do I（倒裝）
姊姊從不獨自出門：older sister … never … alone
在颱風天：during typhoons／on typhoon days
explain: 前半句用 never 表否定，附和時用 neither 加助動詞再加主詞。原動詞是 goes，配合 I 改用 do；不能寫 neither I do，也不能用 neither am I。

subject: english
q: 鎮上的老水塔比當地其他任何一棟建築物都高。
answer: The old water tower in town is taller than any other building in the town.
points: 比其他任何建築高：taller than any other building
鎮上的老水塔：the old water tower in town
當地：in the town／in the area
explain: 比較級加 than any other 與單數名詞，可表達同一範圍中最高。水塔本身也屬於建築物，因此 other 不能省略，building 不能改成複數。

subject: english
q: 這本雙語字典的重量是那本口袋字典的兩倍。
answer: This bilingual dictionary is twice as heavy as that pocket dictionary.
points: 兩倍重：twice as heavy／twice as much（後接 as）
這本雙語字典：this bilingual dictionary
那本口袋字典：that pocket dictionary
explain: 倍數加 as 加形容詞原級，再接 as 比較對象，因此用 heavy，不是 heavier。也可用 This bilingual dictionary weighs twice as much as that pocket dictionary. 表達。

subject: english
q: 毫無疑問，設定明確的目標能讓學生更有效率地讀書。
answer: There is no doubt that setting clear goals helps students study more efficiently.
points: 毫無疑問：there is no doubt that
設定明確目標：setting clear goals
幫助學生：helps／can help students (to) study
更有效率地：more efficiently
explain: There is no doubt that 後接完整子句。setting clear goals 作主詞時用單數動詞 helps，不因 goals 是複數就用 help；也可寫 can help students (to) study，can 後用原形。

subject: english
q: 如果學校現在有更多經費，就會在屋頂安裝太陽能板。
answer: If the school had more money now, it would install solar panels on the roof.
points: 若有就會裝：if … had …, … would install
現在更多經費：more money now
屋頂裝太陽能板：install solar panels on the roof
explain: 與現在事實相反的條件，用 if 加過去式 had，主句用 would 加原形 install。這裡的 had 不表示過去時間，也不能在 if 子句內寫 would have。

subject: english
q: 這家餐廳優先選用本地蔬菜，而不是進口蔬菜。
answer: This restaurant gives priority to local vegetables rather than imported ones.
points: 而不是：rather than／instead of
優先選用：gives priority to
本地蔬菜：local vegetables
進口蔬菜：imported ones／vegetables
explain: rather than 在此連接兩個名詞片語，表示選擇前者。ones 代替複數的 vegetables，不能用單數 one；give priority to 表示優先考慮。

subject: english
q: 多虧及早收到警報，村民在洪水來襲前就抵達安全地點。
answer: Thanks to the early warning, the villagers reached a safe place before the flood arrived.
points: 多虧：thanks to／because of … early warning
村民抵達：the villagers reached
安全地點：a safe place／safety
洪水來襲前：before the flood arrived／hit
explain: thanks to 後接名詞片語，通常說明正面的原因，也可用 because of。reach 是及物動詞，直接接 a safe place，不能多加介系詞 to。

subject: english
q: 居民想出了一個新方法，讓老屋也能成為社區的活動空間。
answer: The residents came up with a new way to turn old houses into spaces for community activities.
points: 想出了：came up with
一個新方法：a new way
把老屋變成空間：turn old houses into spaces
社區活動用：for community activities
explain: come up with 表示想出主意，過去式是 came up with，with 不可漏掉。turn A into B 表示把 A 變成 B；way 後用不定詞說明方法的內容。

subject: english
q: 為了防止地方語言消失，研究人員持續記錄長輩的故事。
answer: To prevent local languages from disappearing, researchers continue to record older people's stories.
points: 防止消失：prevent … from disappearing
地方語言：local languages
持續記錄：continue to record／… recording
長輩故事：older people's／told by older people
explain: prevent 加受詞再接 from V-ing，不能寫 prevent local languages to disappear。older people 指較年長的人，所有格要寫成 older people's。

subject: english
q: 她善用每天搭公車的時間，聆聽英文有聲書。
answer: She takes advantage of her daily bus ride to listen to English audio books.
points: 善用：takes advantage of
每天搭公車的時間：her daily bus ride／rides
聆聽：listen to
英文有聲書：English audio books／audiobooks
explain: take advantage of 在此表示善用時間，of 不能漏掉。聆聽的 listen 要加 to 才能接書籍；有聲書也可寫成 audiobooks。

subject: english
q: 經歷長時間缺水後，我們不再把乾淨的自來水視為理所當然。
answer: After a long water shortage, we no longer take clean tap water for granted.
points: 視為理所當然：take … for granted
長時間缺水後：after a long water shortage
不再把乾淨自來水：no longer … clean tap water
explain: take A for granted 表示把 A 視為理所當然，受詞 clean tap water 放在 take 與 for 之間。no longer 已是否定，不可再加 not；tap water 不可數。

subject: english
q: The job pays little, but trainees can ____ practical skills by working beside experienced workers.
explain: acquire 是「習得、獲得」，在實作中學會技能。purchase 是「購買」、borrow 是「借入」、exchange 是「交換」，都不表示逐步學會技能。

subject: english
q: The new guide hopes to ____ the hikers’ trust by checking every route carefully before each trip.
explain: earn 除了「賺取」也可指以努力「贏得」信任；仔細確認路線是爭取信任的行動。charge 是「收費」、owe 是「欠」、rent 是「租用」。

subject: english
passage:
At the school costume room, students used to leave borrowed jackets on a table. The helpers then had to guess which play each jacket belonged to. To solve the problem, Mina introduced paper tags with the names of the plays. Students attached them to the jackets before returning the clothes. The tags helped the helpers sort the clothes, but some fell off during washing.
The drama teacher suggested putting each play’s clothes in a separate bag. Mina worried that this arrangement would hide wet clothes from view, so she asked students to hang damp items on a rail first. Dry ones could go straight into the bags. The teacher agreed to try the plan for a week.
On Friday, the helpers found every jacket without opening all the bags. They still checked the rail before leaving, since anything hanging there needed more time to dry. Mina kept a few paper tags for unusual items that did not belong to a particular play.
q: What does “them” in paragraph 1 refer to?
explain: them 指 paper tags（紙標籤）；attach A to B 是「把 A 附在 B 上」。學生把標籤掛到外套上，因此不是把外套掛到外套上。

subject: english
passage:
At the school costume room, students used to leave borrowed jackets on a table. The helpers then had to guess which play each jacket belonged to. On Friday, the helpers found every jacket without opening all the bags. They still checked the rail before leaving, since anything hanging there needed more time to dry. Mina kept a few paper tags for unusual items that did not belong to a particular play.
q: What does “this arrangement” in paragraph 2 refer to?
choices: Sorting returned jackets by their paper tags
Keeping each play’s clothes in a separate bag
Checking the costume room at the end of the week
Hanging all returned jackets on the same rail
explain: this arrangement（這項安排）回指老師提出的分袋存放方式。Mina 擔心袋子會遮住濕衣物，才另提先晾乾的步驟。

subject: english
passage:
At the school costume room, students used to leave borrowed jackets on a table. The helpers then had to guess which play each jacket belonged to. To solve the problem, Mina introduced paper tags with the names of the plays. Students attached them to the jackets before returning the clothes. The tags helped the helpers sort the clothes, but some fell off during washing.
The drama teacher suggested putting each play’s clothes in a separate bag. Mina worried that this arrangement would hide wet clothes from view, so she asked students to hang damp items on a rail first. Dry ones could go straight into the bags. The teacher agreed to try the plan for a week.

q: What does “ones” in “Dry ones” refer to?
explain: ones 代替前句的 items，指衣物。damp items（潮濕衣物）先掛起，dry ones（乾衣物）則直接入袋；不是指乾燥的袋子。

subject: english
q: The disease is ____, so patients need years of care rather than a single short course of treatment.
explain: chronic 是「慢性的」，years of care 是長期病程的線索。contagious 是「會傳染的」、fatal 是「致命的」、inherited 是「遺傳的」，皆未必需要多年照護。

subject: english
q: The chemical is ____ even in small amounts; workers must prevent it from entering their bodies.
explain: toxic 是「有毒的」，少量進入人體也有危害。artificial 是「人造的」、harmless 是「無害的」、beneficial 是「有益的」，都不能說明此健康危害。

subject: english
q: After recovering, she was ____ to that strain of the virus; later exposure did not make her ill.
explain: immune to 是「對……有免疫力的」，此處康復後再次接觸同一病毒株仍未生病。vulnerable 是「易受傷害的」、indifferent 是「不在意的」、hostile 是「敵視的」。

subject: english
q: The board will ____ the safety policy: the same rules will remain, but the wording will be made clearer.
explain: revise 是「修訂」，此處保留規則內容而改清楚措辭。abolish 是「廢除」、suspend 是「暫停」、enforce 是「強制執行」，不表示修改文字。

subject: english
q: Staffing problems forced the hospital to ____ its training program for a month; sessions will resume in June.
explain: suspend 是「暫停」，一個月後 resume（恢復）是關鍵。abolish 是「廢除」、implement 是「實施」、expand 是「擴大」，皆不符合暫時中止。

subject: english
q: Posting a rule was not enough; guards were hired to ____ it by checking every visitor’s bag at the gate.
explain: enforce 是「強制執行」；聘人逐一檢查，讓公告的規定落實。revise 是「修訂」、propose 是「提出」、abolish 是「廢除」，都不是實際查驗的動作。

subject: english
q: Before publishing the students’ photographs, the magazine sought their parents’ ____ in writing.
explain: consent 是「同意、允許」，刊登照片前先取得家長書面同意。obligation 是「義務」、privilege 是「特權」、attendance 是「出席」，都不是刊登授權。

subject: english
q: Senior members can use the private lounge, a ____ that is not included in the basic membership.
explain: privilege 是「特權、特殊待遇」，較高會籍才有休息室使用權。procedure 是「程序」、obligation 是「義務」、petition 是「請願書」，並非會員享有的待遇。

subject: english
q: Giving one team the answers before a contest was treated as ____, and the judge was removed from office.
explain: misconduct 是「不當行為」，裁判事先洩漏答案違反職責，因此遭撤職。competition 是「競爭」、negotiation 是「協商」、cooperation 是「合作」。

subject: english
q: Residents signed a ____ asking the council to save the old theater; the document was delivered on Monday.
explain: petition 是「請願書」，由居民簽署並提交訴求。license 是「執照」、receipt 是「收據」、contract 是「契約」，不符合向議會請求保留戲院的文件功能。

subject: english
q: Passengers check in at the airport ____ before buses take them from this building to their planes.
explain: terminal 是「航廈、終點站」，此處指候機建築。warehouse 是「倉庫」、corridor 是「走廊」、basement 是「地下室」，皆非候機建築的名稱。

subject: english
q: The factory installed filters to reduce the ____ of harmful gases into the air around nearby homes.
explain: emission 是「排放」，此處指氣體排入周邊空氣。consumption 是「消耗」、absorption 是「吸收」、conservation 是「保育、節約」。

subject: english
q: Water leaked onto the stairs overnight, creating a ____ that staff removed before anyone slipped.
explain: hazard 是「危險因素」，樓梯上的水會使人滑倒。symptom 是「症狀」、shelter 是「庇護處」、resource 是「資源」，不是此處待排除的環境危害。

subject: english
q: After losing a day to rain, the crew worked on Saturday to ____ the lost time and finish on schedule.
explain: make up for（彌補）指補回損失的時間。keep track of（追蹤）、make room for（騰空間）不合；catch up with（追上）接領先者，不接 lost time。

subject: english
q: ____ having little experience, the new team passed a test that even skilled workers found difficult.
explain: In spite of（儘管）表經驗少卻通過難關的讓步。As a result of（由於）、In addition to（除……還）、In preparation for（為……準備）不合語意。

subject: english
q: ____ the lock, which requires a small key, every part of the machine can be adjusted without tools.
explain: other than（除了……之外）排除需要鑰匙的鎖。in addition to、along with 表增補，會把鎖也算入免工具的部分；in place of（代替）不合語意。

subject: english
q: For the camping trip, we need ____; we already have enough tents.
explain: equipment（裝備）是不可數名詞，可用 some 修飾，不加 a 或複數 s。若要計數，須說 pieces of equipment。不是所有看似一件件的物品名詞都可數。

subject: english
q: At the packing station, workers put the eggs into empty ____ before sending them to stores.
explain: egg box 是「蛋盒」，前面的 egg 作名詞修飾語，通常保持單數；多個蛋盒把核心名詞 box 改為 boxes。不能因內容有多顆蛋就把 egg 也加 s。

subject: english
q: Three ____ attended the family meeting; each was married to one of the host’s sons.
explain: daughter-in-law 是「媳婦」，複數加在核心名詞 daughter 上，成為 daughters-in-law；in-law 是後面的關係修飾語，不在 law 或 in 加 s。

subject: english
q: The hotel can store two large ____ per guest while rooms are being cleaned.
explain: luggage（行李）不可數，計數用 piece of luggage；two 後須把 piece 改成 pieces，但 luggage 不加 s。large 是「大型的」。

subject: english
q: The director asked us to show our ID at the gate. What does “ID” stand for here?
explain: ID 是 identification（身分證明）的縮略形式。information 是「資訊」、instruction 是「指示」、introduction 是「介紹」，都不是門口要查驗的證件。

subject: english
q: A weather service hopes to foresee problems. The prefix in "foresee" suggests knowing about them ____.
explain: fore- 表「在……之前」，foresee 是「預見」，表示問題發生前就知道可能出現。不是事情發生後、從附近，或與事情同時發生。

subject: english
q: The museum is collecting postwar letters. Which letters fit that description?
choices: Letters sent to prevent a war
explain: post- 表「在……之後」，postwar 是「戰後的」，所以是戰後寄出的信。戰前用 prewar；戰時或為阻止戰爭而寄的信，都不是 post- 所表的時間。

subject: english
q: A map marks an underground passage. The prefix in "underground" places the passage ____ the surface.
explain: under- 表「在……下面」，underground 是「地下的」，所以選 beneath（在下方）。beyond 是「超出」、alongside 是「在旁」、across 是「橫越」。

subject: english
q: The coach called a player overconfident. What does the prefix suggest about the player's confidence?
explain: over- 在此表「過度」，overconfident 是「過度自信的」，即自信超出合理程度。不是不足、與別人相等或再次發生。

subject: english
q: The prefix "tri-" in "triangle" tells us how many angles it has. How many does it indicate?
explain: tri- 表「三」，triangle 是「三角形」，有三個角。One（一）、Two（二）、Four（四）都不是 tri- 表示的數量。

subject: english
q: Which noun formed from "accept" means agreeing to take an offer or join a program?
explain: accept（接受）加 -ance 形成 acceptance（接受）。agreement（協議）、approval（批准）意思相關，卻不是同根名詞；access 是「使用權」。

subject: english
q: The office permits visitors only with advance notice. Please ask for ____ before bringing a friend.
explain: permit（允許）變抽象名詞為 permission。名詞 permit 是可數的「許可證」，此處少了冠詞；promise 是「承諾」、proposal 是「提案」。

subject: english
q: A witness described the robber in detail. Which noun formed from "describe" names the account she gave?
explain: describe 轉為 description（描述內容），-ibe 改為 -iption。explanation、statement、report 雖語意相關，皆非同根名詞。

subject: english
q: Which noun formed from "choose" completes "We must make a ____ between the two designs"?
explain: choose（選擇）變為 choice（選擇），oo 變 oi、字尾變 -ce。make a choice 是「做選擇」；charge（費用）、change（改變）、chance（機會）非同根名詞。

subject: english
q: Builders will ____ the pool by adding ten meters at one end; its width will stay the same.
explain: length（長度）加 -en 形成 lengthen（加長），符合只增加池長。strengthen 是「加強」、loosen 是「鬆開」、widen 是「加寬」，都不表示此處的尺寸變化。

subject: english
q: The larger text will ____ older readers to use the app without changing its content.
explain: en- 與 able 構成 enable，enable someone to V 表「使某人能夠……」。ensure 是「確保」、enlarge 是「放大」、enclose 是「圍住」，搭配皆不合。

subject: english
q: By next June, I ____ at this shelter for a year, and I plan to stay longer.
explain: By next June（到明年六月）是未來參照點，用 will have been volunteering 表「將已持續擔任志工」。for a year 是累積期間，其他完成進行式的參照點不合。

subject: english
q: The painting was gone when we returned at noon; someone ____ it while we were away.
explain: 先偷畫，後在中午回來發現畫不見；had stolen（早已偷走）把偷畫放在過去參照點 returned 之前。has stolen 以現在為參照，另外兩項則表未來。

subject: english
q: In which sentence is the subject affected by a change even though the verb is active?
choices: The balloon burst in the heat.
explain: burst（爆裂）在此是不及物動詞，氣球是發生變化的事物，動詞仍用主動形式。其餘句子的主詞是關店、翻書或融化奶油的動作執行者。

subject: english
q: Which sentence can complete the report in standard English: “After the storm, ____”?
choices: a serious problem had been arisen
explain: arise（出現、產生）是不及物動詞，不用被動。過去式為 arose，過去分詞為 arisen；problem 是「問題」，不是某人施加 arise 動作的受詞。

subject: english
q: Which sentence describes a state rather than an action of seating someone?
choices: The host seated the late guests.
The staff are seating the guests.
The guide seated us near the door.
The guests stayed seated during the speech.
explain: stayed seated 表「保持坐著的狀態」，seated 是分詞形容詞。其餘句子的 seat 是「安排……入座」的動詞：host、staff、guide 都是安排別人入座的人。

subject: english
q: This suitcase ____ ten kilograms when empty, so I need a lighter one for the flight.
explain: weigh 表「重達……」時用主動形式，接重量 ten kilograms（十公斤）。其餘被動形式表示行李「被秤重」，不能直接以這裡的重量受詞表達本身有多重。

subject: english
q: This soup ____ salty; add some water before serving it.
explain: taste 作連綴動詞表「嚐起來」，用主動形式接形容詞 salty（鹹的），描述湯的味道。被動的 tasted 表「被品嚐」，不能在此接 salty 表達湯的味道。

subject: english
q: Not only the driver but also the passengers ____ required to wear seat belts on every trip.
explain: not only A but also B 連接主詞時，動詞依較近的 B；passengers（乘客）為複數，所以用 are required（被要求）。不能只依 driver（駕駛）選單數。

subject: english
q: The editor and the photographer ____ both approved the final page; they work in different offices.
explain: 兩個身分各有 the，且後文 they（他們）在不同辦公室工作，指兩人；現在完成式用 have approved（已核准），而非 has。

subject: english
q: The volunteers, as well as their leader, ____ been given keys so they can open the center themselves.
explain: as well as（以及）後的附加成分不改變主要主詞 volunteers（志工們）的複數性，用 have been given（已獲發）。不能受單數 leader 影響。

subject: english
q: Either the two assistants or the manager ____ to sign this form before payment can be made.
explain: either A or B 連接主詞，依較近的 manager（經理）用單數 has；has to sign 表「必須簽署」。不能受前面 two assistants（兩位助理）影響。

subject: english
q: The theater sold all its tickets in an hour, ____ surprised even its manager.
explain: which 回指「一小時內票全售完」這整件事，補充它令人驚訝。非限定關係子句不能用 that；what 已包含先行詞，也不能這樣接在逗號後。

subject: english
q: We stayed with my aunt, ____ garden supplied most of the vegetables for our meals.
explain: whose 是「……的」，whose garden 表示姑姑的花園；garden 已是 supplied 的主詞，空格須表示所有關係，不能只用 who 或 whom。

subject: english
q: One concern is ____ the new gate will block wheelchair access; that is why the design must change.
explain: that 引出 concern（擔憂）的內容，作 be 後的名詞子句。「新門會擋住輪椅通道」已是完整敘述，that 不擔任子句內的主詞或受詞。

subject: english
q: Which sentence keeps its meaning and remains grammatical when “that” is removed?
choices: That the back window was open worried me.
The window that faces the street was open.
That the back window was open was clear.
I noticed that the back window was open.
explain: notice（注意到）後受詞名詞子句的 that 可省略。句首主詞子句的 that 須保留；that faces the street（面向街道）中的 that 是關係子句主詞，不能省略。

subject: english
q: Please record ____ remains after the sale; we need an exact list of the unsold items.
explain: whatever 是「任何……的東西」，兼作 remains 的主詞，整個子句作 record（記錄）的受詞。whether 是「是否」，不能補主詞；whoever 與 whomever 指人。

subject: english
q: The repair cost much more than ____ we had saved, so we had to borrow money.
explain: what we had saved 是「我們先前存下的錢」，what 兼作 saved 的受詞；前面沒有先行詞，不能直接用 which，that 也不能補上缺少的受詞。

subject: english
q: We know the trip lasts two hours, but please check ____; we still need to arrange a meeting time.
choices: how long does the boat take
explain: 要安排集合時間，需問 when（何時）出發；航程兩小時已知，無須再問 how long（多久）。check 後為間接問句，用直述語序 the boat leaves，不倒裝加 does。

subject: english
q: The host asked if Mia needed a ride. Which sentence reports the same question?
choices: The host asked what Mia would do if she needed a ride.
The host asked why Mia needed a ride.
The host asked whether Mia needed a ride.
The host asked when Mia would need a ride.
explain: asked if 在此是「詢問是否」，等同 asked whether；what ... if 則問假設需要接送時會怎麼做，why 與 when 分別問原因與時間。ride＝搭便車、接送。

subject: english
q: Lena wonders whether to repair her bike. Which rewrite keeps both the meaning and the decision-maker?
choices: Lena wonders whether she should repair her bike.
Lena wonders whether her brother should repair his bike.
Lena knows that she should repair her bike.
Lena wonders why she should repair her bike.
explain: whether to repair 表「是否要修理」，省略的動作執行者是 Lena，可還原為 whether she should repair；換成哥哥、已知道或詢問原因都改變原意。

subject: english
q: Which sentence treats the claim's truth as a question to investigate?
choices: The debate shows that the claim is true.
The debate explains why the claim is true.
The debate assumes that the claim is true.
The debate examines whether the claim is true.
explain: examines whether 表「探討是否」，尚未認定主張為真；其餘分別表顯示為真、解釋為真的原因及假設為真。claim＝主張；examine＝探討、檢視。

subject: english
q: The coach repeated the plan so that nobody would miss a step. What does the so that clause express?
choices: What made the coach repeat the plan.
What the coach intended to achieve.
How often the coach repeated the plan.
How clearly the coach explained the plan.
explain: so that 引出目的「以便沒有人漏掉步驟」，說明教練想達成什麼；不是解釋重複的原因或清楚程度。intend＝打算。

subject: english
q: The bread took longer ____ I expected, although I baked it exactly ____ the recipe instructed.
explain: longer than I expected 表「比我預期久」；as the recipe instructed 表「按照食譜指示」。as if 是「彷彿」，不表實際照指示操作。recipe＝食譜。

subject: english
q: The tent held fewer people than we had expected, but more than the cabin did. Which comparison follows?
choices: The cabin held more people than the tent did.
The tent held as many people as we had expected.
The cabin held fewer people than we expected for the tent.
The cabin held as many people as we expected for the tent.
explain: 預期帳篷人數＞帳篷實際人數＞小屋人數，因此預期帳篷人數也多於小屋人數。fewer ... than＝比……少；cabin＝小屋。

subject: english
q: The floor shakes as if a train were passing below. The speaker is describing ____.
choices: a movement known to be caused by a train
a movement resembling the shaking caused by a train
a movement unlike that caused by a train
a movement intended to stop a passing train
explain: as if 表「彷彿」，用火車經過造成的震動作類比，未證實真有火車。resemble＝像；unlike＝不像。

subject: english
q: The hall is as wide as it is long. Which description matches?
explain: as wide as it is long 表「寬度和長度相同」，第二個 as 後接子句 it is long；未比較高度。width＝寬度；length＝長度。

subject: english
q: The app is not as easy to use as the guide suggests. The guide makes it sound ____ than it is.
explain: not as easy ... as 表實際沒有指南所說的容易，因此指南把操作說得更容易。suggest＝暗示；easy to use＝容易使用。

subject: english
q: Nora's arriving early ____ a surprise yesterday, since she usually kept us waiting.
explain: Nora’s arriving early「Nora 提早抵達」是一整件事，作單數主詞；yesterday 表過去，故用 was。Nora’s 標示抵達的人，不是與其他人並列。

subject: english
q: His job is testing water samples. What does testing water samples describe here?
choices: The work he is responsible for.
The work he has already finished.
The work he hopes to avoid.
The work he will assign to others.
explain: testing water samples 作主詞補語，說明工作內容「檢驗水樣」；不是完成式，也沒有表示想逃避或交辦。responsible for＝負責。

subject: english
q: It was careless ____ Max to post the password; it was then easy ____ strangers to read it.
explain: careless「粗心的」評價 Max 的行為，用 of Max；easy「容易的」評價讀取密碼這件事，用 for strangers 標示讀取的人。password＝密碼。

subject: english
q: It took two weeks for the team to repair the roof. What took two weeks?
choices: The team's waiting to use the roof.
The roof's falling onto the team.
The team's planning to repair the roof.
The team's repair of the roof.
explain: It 是虛主詞，承接 for the team to repair the roof「團隊修理屋頂」；花兩週的是修繕這件事，不是等待或規劃。roof＝屋頂。

subject: english
q: The wide doors make ____ possible for wheelchair users to enter without help.
explain: make it possible for 人 to V 中 it 是虛受詞，真正內容是讓輪椅使用者自行進入。wide doors＝寬門；wheelchair＝輪椅。

subject: english
q: I think it unfair for Ken to do all the cleaning. What is judged unfair?
choices: Ken refusing to do any cleaning.
Everyone sharing the cleaning with Ken.
Ken having to do all the cleaning.
Everyone asking Ken to judge their work.
explain: it 指後面的 for Ken to do all the cleaning，評為不公平的是由 Ken 包辦清潔；沒有說他拒做。unfair＝不公平的。

subject: english
q: Visitors came to buy local goods, but some objected to ____ extra for a bag.
explain: came to buy 的 to 引導不定詞；object to「反對」的 to 是介系詞，後接 paying。extra＝額外的費用；local goods＝當地商品。

subject: english
q: The team is committed to ____ food waste, even when sorting leftovers takes extra time.
explain: be committed to 表「致力於」，to 是介系詞，後接 reducing，不是不定詞 to reduce。food waste＝食物浪費；leftovers＝剩菜。

subject: english
q: After months of training, Eva finally succeeded in ____ across the bay without stopping.
explain: succeed in 表「成功做到」，in 是介系詞，後接動名詞 swimming。across the bay＝橫越海灣；without stopping＝不停下。

subject: english
q: Keep your voice down. Dad appears ____; his eyes are closed and his breathing is slow.
explain: 閉眼、呼吸緩慢及要求放低音量，指向爸爸「正在睡覺」，用 to be sleeping；完成式只表先前睡過或被叫醒，習慣式也不表此刻狀態。

subject: english
q: When interviewed on Monday, Ada claimed ____ the missing bag the day before.
explain: 找到包包在週日，早於週一聲稱的時間，用完成式不定詞 to have found；to be found 是「被找到」，會把 Ada 當成被找到的人。claim＝聲稱。

subject: english
q: At fifteen, Maya hoped to win an Olympic medal. The winning was presented as ____.
choices: a future possibility relative to her hope
an event completed before she began to hope
an activity in progress while she was hoping
a victory she remembered from her childhood
explain: hoped to win「希望贏得」中，to win 指相對於當時希望而言的未來可能；hoped 雖是過去式，仍不表示當時已獲獎。medal＝獎牌。

subject: english
q: In 'I regret having ignored her warning,' which event is presented as earlier?
explain: having ignored 是完成式動名詞，將忽視警告放在後悔之前。regret＝後悔；ignore＝忽視；warning＝警告。

subject: english
q: Ben claims to have been painting for hours. The painting is presented as ____.
choices: an activity planned to begin after the claim
a habit starting at the moment of the claim
an activity completed just as the claim begins
an activity continuing over a period before the claim
explain: to have been painting 是完成進行式不定詞，強調說話前已持續一段時間的作畫過程；不保證已畫完。claim＝聲稱。

subject: english
q: No machines are needed: these delicate cups require ____ by hand.
explain: require 後用動名詞可表被動：require washing＝require to be washed，杯子是被洗的。delicate＝易損的；by hand＝用手。

subject: english
q: The road ____ by volunteers, the rescue truck could finally reach the village.
explain: road 是另列主詞，by volunteers 表道路由志工清理；清理先完成，救援車才抵達，用 having been cleared。rescue＝救援；volunteer＝志工。

subject: english
q: With the child ____ her hand tightly, Mei crossed the busy street.
explain: child 是 holding 的主詞，孩子主動「緊握她的手」；held 或被動形式無法在此再接 her hand 作受詞。tightly＝緊緊地。

subject: english
q: The last bus having left, the hikers called a taxi. Why did they call?
choices: The final bus was about to arrive.
The hikers had missed their taxi.
The final bus had already departed.
The hikers were driving the final bus.
explain: the last bus 是 having left 的主詞；完成分詞表公車先離開，才有叫車的行動。depart＝離開；hiker＝健行者。

subject: english
q: With two seats reserved for late arrivals, dinner began. What was the situation of those seats?
choices: They were occupied by early guests.
They were still waiting to be brought into the dining room.
explain: with 後的 seats 是 reserved 的主詞，表示席位被預留給晚到者，仍保留可用；不是移走或已坐滿。reserve＝預留；available＝可用的。

subject: english
q: Other conditions being equal, we would choose the cheaper room. The opening assumes that ____.
choices: the cheaper room has better service
we know the prices but nothing else about the rooms
the prices are equal but the rooms differ in size
the rooms are alike in other relevant ways
explain: Other conditions 是 being equal 的主詞，表「其他條件相同的話」，在相同條件下比較房價。relevant＝相關的；alike＝相同、相似的。

subject: english
q: Without the sea breeze, this room would feel much hotter. What is implied about the breeze now?
choices: It is making the room hotter.
It has stopped reaching the room.
It helps keep the room cool.
It will start only after sunset.
explain: Without ... would 假設現在沒有海風的結果；實際有海風，讓房間沒那麼熱。breeze＝微風；imply＝暗示。

subject: english
q: Jill cannot reach the shelf. If she ____ a little taller, she could get the jar herself.
explain: 與現在身高不夠的事實相反，if 子句用 were，主句用 could get。jar＝罐子；herself＝她自己。

subject: english
q: It is high time we replaced these locks. What does the speaker mean?
choices: Replacing them has just become possible.
They should already have been replaced.
They were replaced long before now.
They will need replacing in several years.
explain: It is high time 加過去式表「早該做了」，含應做而尚未做的意思；replaced 不是報告以前已換過。lock＝鎖。

subject: english
q: Tom missed yesterday's match but describes it as if he ____ every minute.
explain: 他沒看昨天的比賽，卻講得像親眼看過；假設與過去事實相反，as if 子句用過去完成式 had seen。miss＝錯過；describe＝描述。

subject: english
q: Ana whispers as if the baby were asleep, but he is playing. Why is were used?
choices: To report a state that ended before she arrived.
To present an unreal state at the present time.
To predict a state that will begin tonight.
To confirm the baby is sleeping while she speaks.
explain: 寶寶正在玩，並沒睡；were 表與現在事實相反，並非敘述過去睡著。whisper＝低聲說話；asleep＝睡著的。

subject: english
q: Which advice correctly warns Leo against sharing a story that has not been checked?
choices: You had better not sharing it yet.
You had better not to share it yet.
You had better do not share it yet.
You had better not share it yet.
explain: had better not 加原形動詞表示「最好不要」，not 放在 better 後，不加 to 或 do。checked＝查證過的；share＝分享。

subject: english
q: I prefer discussing plans face to face ____ exchanging dozens of messages.
explain: prefer A to B 表「比起 B 更喜歡 A」，兩端都可用動名詞；此處 to 是介系詞。face to face＝面對面；dozens of＝數十個。

subject: english
q: I'd rather you ____ the ending when we meet tomorrow; I haven't finished the novel.
explain: would rather 加另一主詞時，對現在或未來的偏好用過去式；tomorrow 排除過去完成式。reveal＝透露；ending＝結局。

subject: english
q: The nurse requested that the patient's name ____ from the public list to protect his privacy.
explain: request 表要求，that 子句用原形；名字被移除，故用 be removed。privacy＝隱私；remove＝移除。

subject: english
q: The rule requires that each visitor ____ a name tag throughout the tour.
explain: require 表要求時，that 子句用原形 wear，即使 each visitor 為單數也不加 s。name tag＝名牌；throughout＝全程。

subject: english
q: It is vital that the extra copy ____ before the files are checked.
explain: 必要性形容詞 vital 後的 that 子句用原形假設語氣；否定被動為 not be deleted。extra copy＝額外的副本；delete＝刪除。

subject: english
q: The guide's suggestion was that everyone ____ the marked path, even in clear weather.
explain: suggestion 的內容子句表建議，用原形 stay；不定詞或動名詞不能直接取代子句動詞。marked path＝有標示的步道。

subject: english
q: ____ the river to rise overnight, the lower road would be closed tomorrow.
explain: Were the river to rise＝If the river were to rise，假設未來河水上漲；had 不能接 to rise。overnight＝一夜之間。

subject: english
q: Choose the conditional opening: ____ a mistake in your booking, please contact us.
explain: Should you notice＝If you should notice「如果你發現」，should 移到主詞前，notice 留在主詞後。booking＝預約。

subject: english
q: The cafe has little space, but a few tables are still available. What can a visitor expect?
choices: Plenty of room, with some tables free.
Limited room, with no tables free.
Plenty of room, with no tables free.
Limited room, with some tables free.
explain: little space 表「空間很少」，space 不可數；a few tables 表「有幾張桌子」，tables 可數。available 表可用，因此是空間有限但仍有空桌。

subject: english
q: The notice says, 'Not all rooms have sea views.' Which statement must be true?
choices: Every room faces away from the sea.
Most rooms have no view of the sea.
Exactly half the rooms face the sea.
At least one room has no sea view.
explain: Not all 表「並非全部」，只保證至少一間沒有海景，不能推知大多數、剛好一半或全部房間沒有海景。sea view＝海景。

subject: english
q: A natural product is not necessarily harmless. Which claim matches this warning?
choices: Being natural does not guarantee safety.
Being harmless rules out being natural.
Being harmful proves a product is artificial.
explain: not necessarily 是「不一定」，天然不保證無害，但也沒說天然必定有害。harmless＝無害的；artificial＝人工的。

subject: english
q: The print is too small for Dad to read without glasses. Which statement follows?
choices: Dad can read this print without glasses.
Dad needs glasses to read this print.
Dad finds the print too large with glasses.
Dad has already read the print without glasses.
explain: too small ... to read without glasses 表字太小，爸爸不戴眼鏡就看不清；print＝印刷字體。未交代是否已閱讀。

subject: english
q: A: May I borrow your bike? B: ____ I need it until noon, but you can have it after that.
choices: Of course, take it right away.
Not right now, I am afraid.
I thought you had lent it to me.
explain: 後句說中午前要用，故先委婉拒絕現在借車；I am afraid 在此是「恐怕」，不是害怕。after that＝那之後。

subject: english
q: A: Let's remove all the benches. B: ____ Some visitors need a place to rest.
choices: I agree; we can use that space for plants.
I'm with you; let's ask workers to clear them.
I see your point, but I'd keep a few benches.
Good idea; we can add some standing tables.
explain: 先表示理解，再用 but 提出保留部分長椅，符合後句有人需要休息。I see your point＝我了解你的想法；bench＝長椅。

subject: english
q: A: I'm sorry I spilled tea on your notes. B: ____ I have another copy.
choices: Don't worry about it. These things happen.
You're welcome. I'm glad they were useful.
Thanks for offering. I'd love some tea.
Please go ahead. You can read them now.
explain: 打翻茶後道歉，對方有副本，可說 Don’t worry about it「別擔心」接受道歉；You’re welcome 回應道謝，其餘分別接受邀請及給予許可。

subject: english
q: The battery life of this laptop is longer than that of my old one. What does that replace?
explain: that 替代 battery life「電池續航力」，比較兩台筆電的續航時間；one 才替代 laptop「筆電」，兩者不可混淆。

subject: english
q: A: Has the parcel arrived? B: I believe so. What does so stand for?
choices: That the parcel will be sent.
That the parcel belongs to B.
explain: believe so 的 so 替代前句整個肯定內容「包裹已抵達」，表相信如此，並非確定證實。parcel＝包裹。

subject: english
q: Eli wanted to apologize but was too nervous to. What follows the final to in the full meaning?
explain: 句尾 to 保留不定詞標記，省略前面已出現的 apologize「道歉」；完整為 too nervous to apologize「緊張得無法道歉」。

subject: english
q: The old printer used more ink than the new one does. What action does does replace?
explain: does 替代動詞片語 uses ink「使用墨水」，新印表機用現在式；one 則替代 printer，不能把兩者的替代內容混淆。

subject: english
q: As cold air enters, Jo says, 'It's rather chilly in here,' looking at the open window. Jo likely wants someone to ____.
explain: 冷空氣進來，又望著開窗，說 chilly「有點冷」暗含希望關窗的請求；rather 在此是「頗、有點」。

subject: english
q: After a long delay, May says, 'Could this line move any slower?' She most likely ____.
choices: wants an estimate of the total waiting time
asks the staff to serve people more slowly
is pleased with the steady pace of service
feels impatient with the slow service
explain: Could this line move any slower? 字面問「還能更慢嗎」，在久候情境中是反問，表抱怨服務太慢，並非真的要求減速。impatient＝不耐煩的。

subject: english
q: The tailor sewed wide ____ of cloth over the jacket's worn elbows to make it last another winter.
explain: strips 是「長條、布條」，可縫在外套磨損的手肘處補強；folds 是「摺痕」，threads 是「線」，clips 是「夾子」，都不符合 strips of cloth（布條）的語意。

subject: english
q: The spinning ride left Owen so ____ that the ground seemed to move even after he stepped off.
explain: dizzy 是「暈眩的」。離開旋轉設施仍覺得地面在動，指出暈眩；guilty 是「內疚的」，rigid 是「僵硬的」。

subject: english
q: Although several publishers rejected her work, the writer ____ in seeking a home for her novel.
explain: persist in 是「堅持做」。被多家出版社拒絕仍繼續尋找，表示堅持；participate in 是「參與」。

subject: english
q: With just one candle burning, the guide could ____ make out the faded writing on the cave wall.
explain: barely 是「勉強、幾乎不」。僅靠一支蠟燭，辨認褪色字跡很困難；roughly 是「大致地」，不表示能見度低。

subject: english
q: The gardener ____ beside the flower bed to pull out weeds without stepping on the delicate young plants.
explain: kneels 是「跪下」，能在花圃旁低身拔草而不踩入花圃；slides 是「滑動」，marches 是「行進」，leaps 是「跳躍」。

subject: english
q: Both sides hoped for a peaceful ____ of the dispute, but neither was willing to accept the proposed agreement.
explain: outcome 是「結果」。爭議雙方都希望有和平的結果，卻不願接受提議的協議；procedure 是「程序」，capacity 是「容量、能力」，origin 是「起源」。

subject: english
q: Workers wore sealed gloves to prevent direct ____ with the liquid that had damaged several metal tools.
explain: contact with 是「與……接觸」。密封手套隔開手與液體；pursuit 是「追求」，relief 是「舒緩」。

subject: english
q: Repeated equipment failures ____ plans to record the concert, leaving the producers without any usable sound.
explain: frustrated 是「阻撓、使無法實現」，設備故障使錄音計畫落空；motivated 是「激發」，justified 是「證明合理」。

subject: english
q: Initially unwilling to share records, the witness became ____ and supplied every document the investigators requested.
explain: cooperative 是「願意合作的」。由不肯交資料轉為提供所有文件，顯示願意配合；defensive 是「戒備自衛的」。

subject: english
q: Rather than accept the first offer, the tenant decided to ____ with the owner over the monthly rent.
explain: bargain with someone over something 是「就某事與某人議價」。租客想協商租金；interfere 是「干涉」，qualify 是「符合資格」。

subject: english

No modern replacement parts fitted it, and the maintenance budget was small. __1__, the students had to design their own tools instead of ordering a complete repair kit. explain: Difficult as the assignment was 表示「雖然任務困難」。讓步子句可把形容詞前置，再接 as；since 是「因為、既然」。

subject: english

A fictional theater association uses floating stages to perform in lakeside towns. The association began with a small group of performers who traveled between lakeside towns. It has 480 members, including 120 who work at its southern training center. Members may train at any center, regardless of their hometown or family background.
Each training center is arranged around an open rehearsal platform. Storage sheds stand along one side, leaving the opposite side clear for moving large stage pieces. At the platform entrance hangs a blue board with a silver circle. Called the return board, it reminds members to bring borrowed tools back before leaving. New learners sometimes mistake it for a performance notice because it occupies such a prominent position. Small practice rooms lie farther away, where beginners can repeat noisy exercises without disturbing a rehearsal.
The association also maintains a custom of wrapping tool handles in colored cloth. New learners begin this practice during their first week. They first cut narrow strips, leave them in colored water overnight, and hang them to dry the next morning. Once dry, the strips are wound tightly around handles. Members replace them whenever they become loose; the whole process is not repeated on a fixed weekly schedule.
The wrapping serves two purposes. It helps sweaty hands hold tools securely, and each color identifies the center that owns a tool. Members say it also reminds them that borrowed equipment represents another person's work. The association does not claim that wrapping makes damaged tools safe. q: What proportion of the association's members do not work at its southern training center?

In this fictional school project, reporters surveyed equal-sized samples of local travelers in five successive rounds. Support began at 32 percent. A student engineering team built an inspection robot called the Foldwalker. It was designed to enter narrow gaps beneath exhibition platforms, where a wheeled machine could become stuck. Its six feet carried pressure sensors. When a foot touched an object, the sensors measured force and sent a signal to a nearby controller. This information helped the robot decide whether to keep pressing or choose another foothold.
To squeeze through a low opening, the Foldwalker could change both its outline and its movement. It folded its legs close to its body, lowered its central frame, and advanced in short sideways steps. Its outer covering remained the same throughout this movement. 
The team's report contained four observations. [1] The complete robot could carry a camera and a small lamp. [2] Its central computer selected the overall destination. [3] All six feet had the same outer covering. [4] Each leg had a local controller that could adjust a foot immediately without waiting for instructions from the central computer. For comparison, an earlier model had sent every foot signal to one central computer before making any adjustment. That arrangement became slow when several feet met obstacles simultaneously.
The team described the new legs as able to make small decisions locally. In a bench test, one detached leg even pulled its foot back when a tester pressed against it, provided its local battery remained connected. The observation did not mean the leg understood the whole route. It showed that one simple protective response could operate without the robot's main computer. Future tests would examine whether this design remained useful on uneven surfaces.
q: Which word completes this summary? “Foot-mounted ____ provided the measurements used to choose a safer foothold.”
